tc24.steps:

tc38.steps:

Enable BGP peering with the remote firewall – "neighbor 172.10.10.2 remote-as 2", network 192.168.168.0/24”. Since peers are not directly connected, use "neighbor 172.10.10.2 ebgp-multihop". Exit back to non-config mode in BGP, save the changes "write file".

network 192.168.168.0/24
neighbor 172.10.10.2 remote-as 2
neighbor 172.10.10.2 ebgp-multihop 255
